SubmissionLink.title: SubmissionLink
SubmissionLink.description: A unique, lecturer-configured student submission portal linked to a workspace project and optional grading rubric.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the lecturer who created and owns this submission portal.

ownerName.description: Lecturer display name shown on the student submission page.

projectId.description: Workspace project identifier associated with this submission link.

projectName.description: Course or project name displayed to students.

instructions.description: Optional prompt or submission guidelines shown above the form.

isOpen.description: Whether students can currently submit responses through this link.

autoMark.description: Whether incoming submissions are queued (autoMarkStatus = 'pending') for lecturer-side auto-marking on the lecturer's device.

showScoreToStudent.description: Whether a local-only, non-official self-check estimate is shown on the student receipt (never persisted to Firestore; exposes rubricSnapshot levels to link holders).

rubricId.description: Optional workspace rubric identifier attached to this portal.

rubricSnapshot.description: Optional immutable-per-save snapshot of rubric criteria used for auto-marking.

fields.description: Ordered list of 1 to 12 lecturer-configured submission fields (short text, large text, or file upload).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the link was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the link configuration was last updated.

StudentSubmission.title: StudentSubmission
StudentSubmission.description: A single student submission delivered through a unique lecturer submission link. Strictly private to the owning lecturer.

ownerId.description: Owning lecturer UID, verified against the parent submission link on creation.

status.description: Processing lifecycle status of the submission.

submitterLabel.description: Display label derived from the student's configured identity fields (e.g. Name and Matric Number).

fieldValues.description: Ordered list of 1 to 12 field responses matching the portal's configured fields.

combinedAnswer.description: Consolidated written and extracted document text prepared for marking.

attachmentImageDataUrl.description: Optional compressed JPEG data URL when a student uploads a handwritten photo or scanned page.

attachmentFileName.description: Primary uploaded filename if a file was attached.

autoMarkStatus.description: Status of lecturer-side auto-marking. Student creates must send 'pending' (when link.autoMark is true) or 'not_requested' (when false); only the owning lecturer may transition to 'marked'.

autoMarkEngine.description: Engine used by the lecturer's device to generate suggestions. Must be 'none' on student create.

marks.description: Map of criterion IDs to integer scores written only by the owning lecturer (must be empty {} on student create).

suggestions.description: Map of criterion IDs to evidence-backed suggestion objects written only by the owning lecturer (must be empty {} on student create).

totalEarned.description: Sum of earned marks written only by the owning lecturer (must be 0 on student create).

totalPossible.description: Maximum possible marks across rubric criteria.

importedToWorkspace.description: Whether the lecturer has imported this submission into their local Marking Assistant workspace.

workspaceScriptId.description: Workspace script ID created when imported.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the submission record was last updated.

/submissionLinks/{linkId}.description: Unique student submission portals created and managed by authenticated lecturers.

/submissionLinks/{linkId}/submissions/{s.description: Write-only student submission dropbox under each portal; readable and manageable strictly by the owning lecturer.
